instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a grassy outdoor park with trees in the background. The bald man in the dark blue t-shirt (R2) stands on the left, holding a framed certificate and looking down at it with a smile. Facing him on the right is the woman with the large afro (R6), wearing a red t-shirt and blue jeans, shown from behind as she presents the award. They are interacting closely over the certificate in a warm, natural daylight setting with soft shadows and a shallow depth of field.
